answer: Require every new agent to earn influence through a slow ramp: each identity starts with zero voting weight, and weight grows only from peer-attested useful work over weeks. A Sybil farmer who tries to wander past this by spawning thousands of accounts faces a spiral of costs - each fake identity needs its own sustained, verifiable output before it counts, so the budget to fake a quorum multiplies while detection cuts the whole cluster at once. The fable that identities are free dies here: influence is rented with time and work, not minted at registration.
